vision_requirement: energy comparison with a conventional baseline on the same hardware

conditions.idle: normal Python orchestrator waiting without an audio processor workload
conditions.cora: monotonic salient AudioFrame construction through the Cora predictive/workspace processor
conditions.conventional: identical monotonic salient AudioFrame construction through fixed-threshold, nearest-frequency, bounded-deque DSP

primary_metrics: median and mean estimated CPU power in milliwatts per trial
frames per second per active trial
estimated total CPU joules per million processed frames
secondary_metrics: estimated combined SoC power when exposed by the sampler
idle-subtracted CPU power with negative values retained rather than clamped
process CPU and peak RSS from the workload report
interpretation_rules: The conventional baseline is intentionally simpler and is expected to use less energy per frame; Cora is not required to win.
powermetrics values are estimates suitable for optimization on one host, not calibrated wall power and not valid for cross-device comparison.
Energy per frame is primary because fixed-duration conditions process different frame counts.
No microphone, speaker, XVF3800, or end-to-end acoustic energy is included.
The dry-run timestamp defect is retained separately and produced no eligible power data.
No result is eligible until the parser fields and sample overlap are verified against actual powermetrics output.
promotion_boundary: Passing closes a same-host estimated CPU-energy comparison for sustained synthetic salient processing only. It does not establish wall-plug, acoustic, mobile, or cross-device efficiency.
